content: The calls of Det_ReportRuntimeError shall invoke all callback functions configured in DetReportRuntimeErrorCallout (ECUC_Det_00010). (SRS_ BSW_00345) Note: In case no Error_Hooks are configured no additional functions are called. How- ever the forwarding to DLT is still active if configured.
